question: The North-Eastern Space Applications Centre is in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **North-Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC)** is a specialized autonomous institution located in **Umiam**, near **Shillong**, in the state of **Meghalaya**.
 
• It was established on **September 5, 2000**, as a joint initiative of the **Department of Space (DOS)** and the **North Eastern Council (NEC)**.
 
• The centre is dedicated to providing **space technology support** for the developmental activities across the **North Eastern Region (NER)** of India.
 
• It utilizes **Satellite Remote Sensing** and **Geographic Information Systems (GIS)** to assist in **natural resource management**, infrastructure planning, and health services.
 
• A primary objective of the centre is to offer **Disaster Management Support** for regional issues like floods, landslides, and forest fires.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Department of Space (DOS):**

 
 
• It is the government body responsible for India's space program and manages the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• Headquartered in **Bengaluru**, it reports directly to the **Prime Minister of India**.
 
 
 
• **North Eastern Council (NEC):**
 
 
• Established under the **North Eastern Council Act, 1971**, it is the nodal agency for economic and social development in the eight states of the region.
 
• It consists of **Arunachal Pradesh**, **Assam**, **Manipur**, **Meghalaya**, **Mizoram**, **Nagaland**, **Sikkim**, and **Tripura**.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Context:**
 
 
• While **Assam**, **Nagaland**, and **Arunachal Pradesh** are integral parts of the **North Eastern Region** and utilize the data generated by **NESAC**, the physical infrastructure of the centre remains situated in **Meghalaya** due to its central accessibility in the hills.
